scope: new TIB model benchmark only; historical120 unchanged
preprocessing: canonical NFC and whitespace technical normalization upstream; metric receives delivered output/source/reference separately

rouge.stemmer: nltk PorterStemmer default mode, tokens length>3
rouge.tokenizer: official Google default lowercase ASCII [a-z0-9], punctuation to spaces; no stopwords

bertscore.idf_fit_policy: no corpus fit; no train/validation/test statistics
bertscore.long_input: project extension, not official full-context BERTScore: direct content token IDs in nonoverlapping 510-token windows with wrappers, global greedy token cosine P/R and harmonic F1
bertscore.wrappers: kept as alignment targets with zero aggregation weight, including each long window; content unk/mask retained
bertscore.claim_limit: native/window equivalence pending actual pinned backend probe; long windows not equivalent full context

source_similarity.role: diagnostic similarity, not factuality/entailment and not claimed exact Ye et al. reproduction
source_similarity.sentence_splitter: rq2_tib_benchmark_metrics.sentences: Latin .!? followed by whitespace; CJK punctuation; newline
source_similarity.pooling: full pinned SentenceTransformer module pipeline; each long sentence direct-token-ID windows; content-token-weighted mean of window sentence vectors then L2
source_similarity.max_seq_length: from pinned sentence_bert_config.json; must bind actual value in ready receipt
source_similarity.window_stride: capacity, no overlap, every original content token exactly once
source_similarity.source_coverage: all sentences streamed batch1; no topN/source truncation

failure_policy.empty_invalid_source_reference_or_output: all quality NULL, explicit reason; selected denominator unchanged
failure_policy.backend_metric_error: affected metrics NULL; independent successful lexical metrics retained

readiness_required: pinned model and tokenizer files with complete hash manifests
actual native/window equivalence and long-input probes
numeric actual max_seq_length and full model module config bindings

supersedes.reason: preselection implementation amendment: bounded-memory hashing of multi-GB asset weights
